case_number: 2025 INSC 172; SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRIMINAL) NO(S). OF 2025 (Diary No. 45970 of 2023)
summary: Exemption from surrendering applicability; Order XXII Rule 5 SC Rules 2013 applies only after sentencing to imprisonment; not applicable to bail cancellation/rejection cases; precedent from Mahavir Arya Kapur Singh cases; petition infructuous as petitioner already surrendered; special leave petition disposed of as infructuous.
legal_provisions_cited: Order XXII Rule 5 of the Supreme Court Rules, 2013
final_judgment: Special leave petition dismissed as infructuous; pending applications disposed of.
